decision: NO-GO for a numerical proposal from the current source; no credible new measurement question established by this finite gate.
validity: All13public case identities accounted for, direct primary method/table schema verified. No target proliferative-fraction or mitotic-count assay/compartment/time linkage authenticated. No numeric outcome read.
value: Even a source with Ki67 and mitoses would need an experimentally consequential unanswered contrast beyond ordinary cell-cycle-duration differences and published grade/prognosis. Current primary offers neither the required linked assays nor such a new result. Its generic histological assessment cannot be transformed into an EMC proliferation comparison.
strongest_alternative: Technical sampling/field area/cell identity/phase durations would dominate unsupported discordance; prior authors/general pathology may already establish the generic contrast. These are reasons to require a specific source-backed question, not explanation for ignored outcomes.
reopening: A concrete public native EMC primary/deposit with same-case/condition/ROI tumor-cell proliferative fraction and area-calibrated mitotic counts, suitable independent comparison, all relevant specimens and a useful unreported measurement implication; freeze statistic/uncertainty/disproof and independent value challenge before endpoints. Otherwise use another genuinely distinct actual assay.
